paragraphs: Rabbi Dostai of Biri; another reading: Bearin. Ulla raised a contradiction to him from what Rav said, “Fish innards …,” against “But it was taught …”; “Remove from here ….” Rabbi Zeira said to him …: Avodah Zarah 40a. Rabbi Dostai of Biri expounded: Eruvin 45a; Bava Kamma 83a; Chelek 107a. Rashi explains Biri as a place. In Yalkut Psalms, section 19: “of Bibi”; it appears to be a scribal error.
